title: Italian Crispy Fried Garlic Bites
description: A crispy and flavorful Italian appetizer made with garlic and a crunchy coating. These bites are perfect for snacking or as a side dish.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
Peel the garlic cloves and separate them into individual buds.
In a bowl, mix together the flour and a pinch of salt.
In another bowl, beat the eggs.
In a third bowl, place the breadcrumbs.
Dip each garlic bud into the flour mixture, then the eggs, and finally the breadcrumbs.
Fry the coated garlic in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
Remove the fried garlic from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Serve the crispy garlic bites hot.
